column1: # texRef\tr\tg\tb\tevidence — multiply the raw texture's RGB by (r,g,b) at pack build; alpha preserved.
# solved from truth/ours median ratios on the gallery triptychs; rounding = python round() to 4 decimals.
# 14-bq THE QUAD-DRIVEN MACHINE FRONTS (run 42243329692, the base-row smooth-light
# deficit): the factory tier composites ride the quad channel; the dump's fake
# Page pins light 15 and shade 1 (QuadDump.Page getBrightness/getShade), so the
# baked tiles carry the AO but NOT the ground-plane smooth-light shadow nor the
# 1.21.1 directional shade the truth renders at the wall's base row (every RED
# cell sits at r0/r1). The deficit = per-texture attributable on the factory
# fronts ONLY: the *_factory_front art rides the ONE camera-facing face (the
# south cells' dominant region, n>2500 per cell), all evidence cells share one
# lighting class (r0, south), and no GREEN row shows the same texture from
# another lighting (the front is invisible from every other facing). The
# per-family tints are NOT cross-averaged (sawing/infusing/crushing have
# distinct front arts). The contested classes stay untinted: the separator body
# (ratio 1.0 on p11's r5/r6 cells vs 0.52 on p12's r0 cells = two lightings, one
# texture), ports/back/side/top/bottom (sliver-level evidence only), and every
# 14-bu THE FLORA TINT EXTENSION (scripts/flora-tints.py, run on the #214
# shard-0 triptychs): the wall's achromatic smooth_stone pulled the tool's
# per-cell medians toward 1.0 and refused the whole flora family; the
# chroma-masked per-pixel median of truth/ours isolates the tinted plant
# pixels (the raw sprites are pre-tint grayscale) and the sway/particle
# minority does not survive the median. The REF rows stay refused honestly:
# high_grass (the age variants scatter past 0.47), bramble_leaves,
# flesh_tendons (the pulsing BE). The bake rides the composite's baked
# sibling sprite — the raw texture keeps serving every untinted consumer.
# 14-by THE #229 CALIBRATION (run 42297037383 crops): the ae2 quartz stairs/
# wall base-row smooth-light deficit (the 14-bq class, this time on the ae2
# chiseled art — every evidence cell sits at r0), the BOP blood fluid's tint
# (n=12196, the strongest single solve of the run), the watergrass vanilla-
# texture pair (the DT/PlantBlock vanilla-texture route, safe: watergrass is
# the ONLY ladder consumer of tall_grass_bottom/top), and the willow_trapdoor
# refinement (the 1.1591 row over-tinted — the #229 p116 pair measured 1.047
# the state-keyed extension (feat/state-tint-bake): rows keyed by the STATE —
# the quad meshes the DT root states capture render VANILLA textures
# (mangrove_roots_side/top, mangrove_log) under the mod's tint; the pack
# re-hosts them per state (_cimtint_s<hash>). The dark_oak_root rows stay
# dormant until DT ships real textures (the captured sprites are runtime-
# generated, minecraft:block/dark_oak_log_top_thick — no jar carries them);
# the fluids are the static composite lane's target (14-bw).
# 14-cc THE #231 RECALIBRATION (run 42359045079 crops, post-14-by tile alpha):
# the content-mask ratios went TIGHT across the leaf families (the black-tile
# contamination gone) and the 14-cb resolver fix (the ok flag no longer
# poisoned by the parent-less block/block holder) let the leaf states resolve
# at all. New rows: red_maple (the strongest leaf solve), snowblossom (a hair
# above 1 — the row is within epsilon of the earlier refusal, kept for the
# residuals solved per-texture where the folds AGREED — the chemical
# crystallizer (4 cells), the combining/injecting/purifying factory fronts,
# the shared mekanism block/bottom (4 dissolution-chamber cells), create
# andesite_casing_short. The brightening rows ride ON TOP of the 14-da
# mesh-gate node tint (measured WITH it engaged — the bake undoes the
# over-dim; the coupling is named in docs/worklog.md).
# the per-TEXTURE route refuses the block==0 machine families — the qio_bus
# sprite carries TWO lightings (the exporter/importer clusters 0.40 vs 0.52),
# the sorter/heater models are multi-texture, laser_amplifier's crops are
# misaligned (shifts to 6px) — and the gate's own luma fit (k in [0.5,2.0])
# cannot reach the 0.39-0.40 cluster either (k floors at 0.5). The rows below
# key on the STATE: tint-calibrate.py 14-db solves each red state's own crops
# (guards: shift<=2px; per-pixel MAD<=0.05 — the tint signature separating
# the uniform-shade machines from the door slide/fold phase (MAD 0.24+) and
# the heater bimodal crops; family [0.35,2.0] — below the fit's floor a
# darkening bake is the only representable instrument and never clips). The
# 14-da mesh gate does NOT tint these meshes (block==0-only), so the bake is
# the only multiplier on them. GalleryPack.applyStateTint re-hosts every
# texture of the state's composite (_cimtint_s<hash8>); the raw sprite keeps
# serving every other consumer — a state row cannot touch a green cell.
